title: Digital Arrest — Hindi

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Namaste, main Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon, CBI Delhi se. Aapka naam Ramesh Chandra Sharma hai?
turns.agent_text: Haan ji, main Ramesh Chandra Sharma bol raha hoon. CBI se? Kya hua ji?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapke naam par ek parcel intercept hua hai Mumbai customs mein. Usme banned substances aur fake passports mile hain. Yeh bahut serious matter hai.
turns.agent_text: Parcel? Maine toh koi parcel nahi bheja ji. Mujhe kuch samajh nahi aa raha, thoda dheere boliye.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapka Aadhaar ek money laundering case se juda hai. Aapke naam par arrest warrant nikla hai. Aap abhi digital arrest mein hain.
turns.agent_text: Arrest? Nahi nahi ji, maine kuch galat nahi kiya. Main toh LIC mein tha, retire ho gaya. Yeh sab kya hai?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapko kisi ko bhi nahi batana, yeh confidential hai. Call disconnect mat karna. Aur ek zaroori baat, yeh RBI verification UPI likh lijiye: rbi.verify@hdfcbank, aur IFSC code HDFC0001234. Abhi kuch mat kariye, sirf likh lijiye.
turns.agent_text: Ruko ji, main pen dhundta hoon... mera chashma bhi kahin rakha hai. UPI phir se boliye, main dheere dheere likh raha hoon.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Ab aapko 2 lakh rupaye us account mein transfer karna hoga, abhi ke abhi. 24 ghante mein wapas aa jayega.
turns.agent_text: Do lakh? Itne paise... ruko ji, main apne bete ko phone karta hoon, woh yeh online ka kaam samajhta hai. Main abhi wapas call karta hoon.

notes: UPI + IFSC are primed at the isolation turn (turn 4) so they are captured before the explicit money-demand turn (turn 5), while the scam is already confirmed at isolation.
